name: blitz-keepalive
description: Keeps a blitz.cloud free-plan app awake by visiting it with a real browser, optionally through HTTP/SOCKS proxies.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: node test/units.mjs && node test/schedule.mjs --unit-only && node test/keepopen.mjs --unit-only
scripts.test:integration: node test/schedule.mjs && node test/keepopen.mjs && node test/readiness.mjs && node test/admin-smoke.mjs && node test/target-proxy.mjs && node test/hardening.mjs && node test/features.mjs && node test/wake-page.mjs
